review:
The latest in Pragmatic's most famous candy series. Eight or more matching treats anywhere on the 6x5 grid pay instantly and tumble away.

Four or more lollipop scatters give 10 free spins, where candy bombs now reach 2,500x, and three more scatters add five spins. The base game is exactly the same as the original; the difference is the much bigger bombs in the bonus. Up to 25,000x, 96.52% RTP.
